beats.text: YouTube started as a dating site.
beats.note: The source is co-founder Jawed Karim himself, in a 2007 commencement speech at the University of Illinois.

beats.text: He said they called it that to generate interest.
beats.note: His words: "To generate interest we just said it was a new kind of dating site." The slogan was "Tune in, Hook up."

beats.name: The Indian Ocean tsunami
beats.role: Karim said there was no good way to find video clips of it online. By February 2005 he and two PayPal colleagues were discussing a video sharing website.

beats.context: What they offered women for every video uploaded, in Craigslist posts in Los Angeles and Las Vegas.

beats.text: So Karim filled it with videos of 747s.
beats.note: By June the site was revamped to be more open and more general.

beats.text: The dating line was the pitch. The idea was video.

beats.line: Read the speech, not the summary.
